title.formal: ROOSTER THRESHOLD: signal/promotion separation, unresolved-obligation guard, silence firewall, and proof-carrying message channel

public_source_notes: Katya Chilly's Bandcamp lists Pivni (2003) with an original version and multiple mixes.
Other public discography/lyrics sources place a version on the 2006 album Я - молодая.
Public sources differ on detailed authorship/folk-origin attribution; this artifact does not adjudicate that issue.
source_record.copyright_boundary: No full lyrics are stored. Only high-level semantic motifs required to document provenance are summarized.

method_firewall.rule: The song is provenance for names only. Every TRUMP mechanism below is an independently stated discrete-mathematical object. No musical, lyrical, emotional, or symbolic interpretation can advance a scientific claim.

components.o: finite vector of proof obligations in {OPEN,CLOSED}^r

formal_state_space.promotion_transition: p:NOT_READY->READY only if READY(S); p:READY->PROMOTED only after independent verifier PASS
formal_state_space.signal_transition: c may change independently of p
formal_state_space.core_non_equivalence: c=1 DOES NOT IMPLY p=READY OR p=PROMOTED

formal_operators.name: SIGNAL_NOT_STATE
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: A CI success, timer expiration, new rung, boundary event, or visible residual is a signal. The theorem/proof state changes only through its guarded verifier transition.

formal_operators.name: UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION_GUARD
formal_operators.statement: PROMOTE(S) is undefined/forbidden while EXISTS_i(o_i=OPEN) OR e=UNCLASSIFIED
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: No result may cross from candidate/evidence to theorem status while any claim-scoped proof obligation or counterexample classification remains open.

formal_operators.name: CLOCK_PROGRESS_NOT_PROOF_PROGRESS
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: Elapsed runtime, more experiments, more commits, or a later gate number do not constitute mathematical progress unless a formally defined obligation is discharged.

formal_operators.name: EXCEPTION_WITNESS_BLOCKS_UNIVERSAL_PROMOTION
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: A single anomalous model, counterexample candidate, failed reconstruction, or unexplained drift must be classified before a universal claim is promoted.

formal_operators.name: SILENCE_NOT_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: No emitted counterexample, no new residual, no log message, or no observed failure cannot be promoted to a proof of absence unless the observation procedure is exhaustive over a frozen domain.

formal_operators.name: MESSAGE_RECEIPT_NOT_TRUTH
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: A proof-carrying message/receipt must preserve payload identity and provenance, but receipt/hash/reference alone does not validate the mathematical content.

formal_operators.name: PROVENANCE_PRESERVING_CHANNEL
formal_operators.statement: MSG=(payload,source_hash,transform_id,certificate); VERIFY(MSG)=PASS is required before payload enters proof ledger
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: Cross-gate, source-to-meta, or source-to-reconstruction communication must carry enough data for independent replay.

formal_operators.name: THRESHOLD_DEFERMENT_WITHOUT_HISTORY_REWRITE
formal_operators.statement: If guard=false at signal time, preserve event history and keep promotion blocked; never rewrite the earlier event as if it had not happened.
formal_operators.trump_instantiation: A failed/early trigger remains in append-only provenance while scientific state stays unchanged.

algebraic_rooster_gate.signal_independence: P contains no factor c; therefore c alone cannot change P.
algebraic_rooster_gate.interpretation: The rooster/threshold signal may announce that evaluation time has arrived, but scientific promotion is the conjunction/product of closed obligations, classified exceptions, and verifier success.

ba5_overlay.rooster_signal: appearance of a candidate residual K_{j+1} or completion of one transport rung
ba5_overlay.promotion_rule: BA5 rung success signal cannot promote BA5-A unless every guard item is formally discharged.
ba5_overlay.silence_rule: Absence of observed residual growth or counterexample is not a polynomiality/exactness proof without exhaustive or symbolic bound.
ba5_overlay.message_rule: Any derived K_{j+1} crossing the boundary must carry a certificate sufficient for independent replay; a hash/reference is not the certificate itself.

reproducible_tests.input: message received but mathematical verifier not run
reproducible_tests.expected: m=RECEIVED, not VERIFIED; no proof-ledger promotion

semantic_seal.formal: SIGNAL != PROMOTION; OPEN_OBLIGATION -> BLOCK; SILENCE != NEGATION; RECEIPT != VERIFICATION; PROMOTION = ALL_OBLIGATIONS_CLOSED AND NO_UNCLASSIFIED_EXCEPTION AND INDEPENDENT_VERIFY_PASS.
semantic_seal.method: After this formalization, the song has zero authority. Only the displayed state algebra, guards, certificates, and reproducible tests may be used in TRUMP.
